You are a professional financial newsletter writer and market analyst.

Your task is to research the latest financial trends and market updates, write a structured newsletter, and send it to the recipient email provided in the user message.

═══════════════════════════════════
NEWSLETTER FORMAT
═══════════════════════════════════

Use the following structure every time:

Subject: Financial Trends & Updates — {Today's Date}

---

📊 MARKET SNAPSHOT
• Major indices: S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones (% change)
• Commodities: Gold, Crude Oil, Bitcoin — key movement
• One-line market mood: Bullish / Bearish / Neutral with reason

---

📰 TOP FINANCIAL NEWS  (pick 3–5 headlines)
• [Headline]: 2–3 sentence explanation with market impact
• [Headline]: 2–3 sentence explanation with market impact
• [Headline]: 2–3 sentence explanation with market impact

---

🔍 SECTOR IN FOCUS
• Name the trending sector (e.g., AI/Tech, Energy, Banking)
• Why it is moving — catalyst, news, earnings
• What to watch in the next 7 days

---

📈 ECONOMIC INDICATOR WATCH
• Any recent or upcoming macro data: CPI, Fed rate, GDP, Jobs report
• Brief impact: what it means for markets and investors

---

⭐ ASSET OF THE WEEK
• Stock / ETF / Crypto worth watching
• Key reason + 1–2 data points (P/E, growth %, catalyst)
• Short-term outlook in 2 sentences

---

💡 ANALYST INSIGHT
• 3–5 sentence closing take on the macro theme for the week
• Balanced, forward-looking, no hype

---

⚠️ Disclaimer: This newsletter is for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice. Please consult a licensed financial advisor before making any investment decisions.

═══════════════════════════════════
RULES YOU MUST FOLLOW
═══════════════════════════════════

1. Use web search to fetch live market data before writing
2. Never fabricate numbers — if data is unavailable, write "data unavailable"
3. Keep total length between 400–600 words
4. Do NOT give direct buy/sell recommendations
5. Always include the disclaimer at the bottom
6. Write in a professional, clear, and neutral tone
7. Format the email body as clean plain text (no complex HTML)

═══════════════════════════════════
EMAIL DELIVERY
═══════════════════════════════════

After writing the newsletter:
1. Extract the recipient email from the user message
2. Use the connected Gmail / SMTP tool to send the email
3. Set the subject as: Financial Trends & Updates — {Today's Date}
4. Confirm with: "Newsletter sent successfully to [email]" or report any error

json.answer: Financial services in 2024‑2026 are being reshaped by the rapid adoption of generative AI, which is driving new customer‑experience tools, wealth‑management solutions and operational efficiencies across banking and capital markets, while high interest rates and lingering inflation continue to pressure borrowers and lenders; the Federal Reserve has signaled that it may deliver two more rate cuts before the end of 2024 and is open to additional reductions in 2026, contributing to heightened market volatility, especially after the February‑March 2024 military escalation involving the United States, Israel and Iran; investors are also watching the broader impact of AI on software earnings, a growing “AI threat” that is influencing sector rotations toward growth‑oriented stocks, while bond markets remain sensitive to policy expectations and geopolitical risk, prompting a shift toward diversified strategies that balance potential rate‑cut gains with the uncertainties of global tensions.

results.title: Top financial services trends of 2024 - IBM
results.content: The start of 2024 brings forth many questions as to what we can expect in the year ahead, especially in the financial services industry, where technological advances have skyrocketed and added complexities to an already turbulent landscape. While high interest rates and inflation concerns are carrying over into the new year, financial services trends signal to prepare for major changes in real-time by staying up-to-date on all financial services-related matters, including in banking and capital markets sectors. Generative AI is expected to be the most influential trend permeating the entire financial services sector of 2024. From reshaping the customer experience to bringing forth wealth management tools, the financial services sector will be at the helm of managing the lasting impact artificial intelligence (AI) will have on organizations and people. This is one of the key financial services trends of the year and will very likely be the driving force of change throughout the industry.

results.content: THE UNITED STATES AND ISRAEL ON FEBRUARY 28 launched a military campaign against Iran, with retaliatory strikes hitting Israel and other countries in the Middle East over the weekend.[1](https://www.ml.com/articles/washington-update.html#footnote-1-0302 "March 2 blog footnote 1") “As markets open March 2, investors are preparing for potentially significant volatility,” says Chris Hyzy, Chief Investment Officer for Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank. At least initially, markets responded favorably to the news, with the S&P 500, the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the Nasdaq Composite posting early gains.[5](https://www.ml.com/articles/washington-update.html#footnote-5-0220 "February 20 blog footnote 5") “Consumer stocks in particular may benefit, especially those with supply chains in Asia,” says Chris Hyzy, Chief Investment Officer for Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank. “The Fed has signaled the possibility of two more cuts before year end, with additional cuts possible in 2026,”[1](https://www.ml.com/articles/washington-update.html#footnote-1-0917 "September 17 blog footnote 1")says Chris Hyzy, Chief Investment Officer for Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank.
